candidates.requirement: Initialize the data producer with the number of bytes actually supplied to the fuzz entry, so preference generation reads only within that input.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput → LZ4_compressBound(size) → FUZZ_dataProducer_create(data, bound) → FUZZ_dataProducer_preferences → FUZZ_dataProducer_retrieve32.
candidates.failure_condition: A one-byte input produces bound 17; the first retrieval reads data[13] before any frame operation.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry calls preference generation unconditionally, and the producer has no bound-to-input check. No later frame path avoids the earlier read.
